description: Follow a poll you can read (any public poll, or your accounts' own), as the person this key belongs to. Following runs nothing and costs nothing: it reads the owner's runs. A real change (a model's answer moving beyond its 95% range since the poll's last change, or a model changing version) is a results.changed event, in list_changes?following=true and to a webhook with scope following. Idempotent. (PUT /api/v1/polls/{id}/follow)

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

name: follow_poll
title: Follow a poll
